label: PF Backlog 214
title: Process: PR workflow -- branch -> pre-check gates (syntax/audit/lint/tests/secrets) -> code review -> merge to develop/main + branch protection
body:
## Problem / why
Work is (so far) committed straight to `develop` with no PR, no required review, and no CI gate on the
change itself -- only `.github/workflows/structure.yml` on push. There is no enforced pre-check (syntax,
audits, tests, lint, secret scan) before code lands, so errors can reach `develop`/`main`.

## Goal & value
Every change lands via a Pull Request that (a) passes automated pre-checks, (b) gets a human review BEFORE
check-in/merge, and (c) is protected by branch rules -- so `develop` always builds and `main` stays releasable.

## Requirements
### Branch model
- `main` = releases only; `develop` = integration; work on `feat/<BI-id>-slug`, `fix/<BI-id>-slug`, `hotfix/<slug>`.
- No direct pushes to `main`/`develop` (enforced by branch protection).
### Pre-check gates (ALL must pass; run by a local hook AND in CI)
- syntax: `python -m compileall -q core scripts dashboard`
- contracts/audits: `python scripts/dev/wired_audit.py` (naming, store-registry, diff, destructive,
  reciprocity, tier/cost, agent-knowledge, PATHS, legacy-frozen)
- tests: `python -m pytest test-framework/tests`
- lint + format + types: add `ruff` (lint/format) and a type check (mypy/pyright) as a new gate
- secret scan: gitleaks/detect-secrets + assert no `.env` / `*.key` is staged
- one aggregate entrypoint `scripts/dev/precheck.py` runs every gate and exits non-zero on any failure
### PR rules
- PR target = `develop`; release PR = `develop` -> `main`.
- PR template: summary, backlog item ref (BI-####), test evidence, risk/rollback.
- CI fails if the PR carries no `BI-####` reference.
- >=1 approving review required; `core/**`, `scripts/**`, `config/**`, and CI files gated via CODEOWNERS.
- All required status checks green; branch must be up-to-date before merge.
### Merge + release
- Feature PRs: squash-merge into `develop` (conventional-commit title).
- Release: merge-commit `develop` -> `main`, then tag and run `core/run_quality_gate.py`.
- Documented in `docs/PR-PROCESS.md` (+ `CONTRIBUTING.md`), seeding from the current `structure.yml`.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- `docs/PR-PROCESS.md` + `.github/pull_request_template.md` + `.github/CODEOWNERS` exist.
- CI workflow runs on `pull_request` to `develop`/`main` and runs all gates above.
- Branch protection on `develop` + `main`: require PR + review + status checks + no force-push.
- A demo PR with an intentional syntax error is blocked; fixed -> green -> approved -> merged.
- A direct push to `develop` is rejected.

## Verification / test plan
- Open a test PR (bad syntax) -> CI red, merge blocked; fix -> CI green.
- Attempt a direct push to `develop` -> rejected.
- `python scripts/dev/precheck.py` locally -> non-zero on an injected error, zero when clean.

dashboard_impact.reason: Repo/CI process only; no product UI change.

_note: relates_to BI-0024 (extends its CI/PR gating to a full review+protection process)
